stem: Given f(x) = x^2 - 36, which statement is true?

options.label: F
options.text: The only zero, 6 , can be found when 0 = (x - 6)(x - 6).

options.label: G
options.text: The only zero, 18, can be found when 0 = (x - 18)(x - 18).

options.label: H
options.text: The zeros, -6 and 6, can be found when 0 = (x + 6)(x - 6).

options.label: J
options.text: The zeros, -18 and 18, can be found when 0 = (x + 18)(x - 18).
